response.justification: Bogdan's extensive experience (over 15 years) is heavily skewed toward senior and leadership roles, with minimal entry-level junior development experience. His focus on diverse languages (D, TypeScript, Node.js, Swift) and frameworks deviates from the required Java/object-oriented programming key requirement. While he meets some desired qualities (innovation, collaboration), his lack of recent Java experience and junior-level project contributions significantly lowers his fit for this entry-level role.
strengths: Fluent English and German (basic, but improving)
Strong background in software development and agile methodologies
Proven ability to work in collaborative and innovative environments
concerns: Lacks recent or relevant Java/object-oriented programming experience
Overqualified with extensive senior/leadership roles, not junior-level contributions
Minimal evidence of working in insurance sector or agile digitalization projects
